entries.title: Minimum wage: federal contractors, $15/hour
entries.question_text: Increase the minimum wage paid to federal contractors to $15 an hour
entries.harmonization: Support for raising the minimum wage is coded liberal; opposition conservative. This item evaluates a specific executive decision for federal contractors, not a universal minimum wage. Keep separate from general and nationwide wage proposals.
